name: h2o_sto3g_d_grad
description: #565's cheap d case: H2O/STO-3G plus one d primitive on O (exponent 0.8), Cartesian, every J and K class through (dd|dd). PySCF's converged RHF, libcint's derivative integrals, vj1 / vk1, each per-atom term of the RHF nuclear gradient and its total.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h2o_sto3g_d_grad
provenance.basis: sto-3g, plus one d primitive on O (exponent 0.8)

density_recipe: rhf: PySCF's converged closed-shell RHF density (total, 2 C_occ C_occ^T, symmetrised as (D + D^T) / 2; conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), recorded; every array is computed from the recorded matrix, which --check holds to 1e-08 of a fresh SCF, not bitwise
